Historical coverage

Biomarker historical review complete through September 4, 2026

This completion claim covers the original biomarker scope. It means the period and every designated source category passed the documented audit. It does not mean every publication was included.

Clinical trials, guidelines, and management backfill

Nine verified 2026 briefs were added after targeted searches of guideline issuers, drug labels, clinical journals, trial records and official conference/sponsor reports. Clinical-trial reports are now separated from biomarker-focused research. This is a selected backfill of material developments, not a completed month-by-month audit of every general AD source category. The original biomarker audit below retains its own scope and dates.

Added September 7, 2026 · 9 verified briefs · Source window January 1, 2026 to September 7, 2026

Clinical trials · Guidelines · Management

Backfill verification notes
  • Source dates use publication or regulatory-action dates; September 2 WHO executive summary and May CELIA topline release are supporting records, not duplicate briefs.
  • ARIA workgroup recommendations are labeled consensus, not a formal CPG. FDA labeling remains distinct.
  • EVOKE numerical tables were verified in the sponsor’s publication deck; primary-publication metadata was verified in the indexed abstract.
  • NICE 2026 draft appraisals were discovered but full primary documents were not retrievable; no final recommendation or coverage change is asserted.
  • Small pilots, narrative reviews and 2024–2025 guidance without a verified 2026 change were not added as new developments.

Audit results

Missing months: pass

Every month from January through August and September 1–4 is represented.

Source categories: pass

Each designated category was searched for every covered month; source-level last-checked dates are in the registry.

Modality balance: pass

Blood, CSF comparison, amyloid PET, and tau PET were explicitly searched; zero qualifying items are retained as zero rather than backfilled with filler.

Regulatory and recall actions: pass

FDA 510(k), drug approval, and recall databases were screened.

Coverage and coding: pass

CMS, MAC, CLFS, private-payer policy, and public PLA/CPT references were screened; policy is not conflated with payment.

Deduplication: pass

DOI, PMID, trial, FDA, recall, and organization identifiers were used; abstracts and releases were merged into definitive records.

Audit performed September 4, 2026. Source-level checked dates are in the registry.
